package.name: vlm_pipeline
package.description: Message-only subset of the full vlm_pipeline package (source of truth: slave Orin 192.168.10.101:~/vlm_loader/vlm_pipeline). Contains the 9 .msg files state_machine depends on, copied byte-for-byte so generated type hashes match the real package. The pipeline node itself (opencv / ffmpeg / curl / shm_msgs) is intentionally NOT included -- this package exists only so state_machine can be built and unit-tested off-vehicle.
